risk_description:
The airbag in the upper B-pillar may not open as intended, increasing the risk of injury in the event of an accident.
Moreover, the B-pillar cladding could become detached and end up inside the vehicle, increasing the risk of injury to vehicle occupants.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
